This mirrors the trail data in RuneLite's built-in Herbiboar plugin, minus the footprint * object IDs. Herbi Stats never draws anything in the world; the locations are here to work out how * far the player had to travel between one spot and the next. */ @Getter enum HerbiSearchSpot { A_MUSHROOM(new WorldPoint(3670, 3889, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_5, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_6, 1)), A_PATCH(new WorldPoint(3672, 3890, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_1, 2)), B_SEAWEED(new WorldPoint(3728, 3893, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_4, 2), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_5, 2), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_1, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_2, 1)), C_MUSHROOM(new WorldPoint(3697, 3875, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_0, 2)), C_PATCH(new WorldPoint(3699, 3875, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_3, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_4, 1)), D_PATCH(new WorldPoint(3708, 3876, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_9, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_0, 1)), D_SEAWEED(new WorldPoint(3710, 3877, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_3, 2), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_2, 2)), E_MUSHROOM(new WorldPoint(3668, 3865, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_3, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_4, 1)), E_PATCH(new WorldPoint(3667, 3862, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_6, 2)), F_MUSHROOM(new WorldPoint(3681, 3860, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_7, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_8, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_3, 2)), F_PATCH(new WorldPoint(3681, 3859, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_2, 2)), G_MUSHROOM(new WorldPoint(3694, 3847, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_0, 2), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_7, 1)), G_PATCH(new WorldPoint(3698, 3847, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_8, 2)), H_SEAWEED_EAST(new WorldPoint(3715, 3851, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_8, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_9, 1)), H_SEAWEED_WEST(new WorldPoint(3713, 3850, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_9, 2), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE11_0, 1)), I_MUSHROOM(new WorldPoint(3680, 3838, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_5, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_6, 1)), I_PATCH(new WorldPoint(3680, 3836, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE9_7, 2), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_4, 2)), J_PATCH(new WorldPoint(3713, 3840, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_8, 2), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE11_3, 1)), K_PATCH(new WorldPoint(3706, 3811, 0), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE10_5, 2), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE11_1, 1), new Trail(VarbitID.HUNTING_TRAIL_STATE11_2, 1)), ; /** * Where the searchable object stands, used to work out how far the player had to travel. */ private final WorldPoint location; private final List trails; HerbiSearchSpot(WorldPoint location, Trail... trails) { this.location = location; this.trails = Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(trails)); } /** * One trail of footprints leading to a search spot. */ @Value static class Trail { /** * The varbit describing this trail's state. Below {@link #value} the trail has not been * walked yet; at {@link #value} the trail is the one currently laid out in front of the * player; above it the spot at the end has already been searched. */ int varbitId; /** * The reference value {@link #varbitId} takes while this trail is the active one. */ int value; } }
